tweets.author: EA SPORTS FC Direct Communication
tweets.text: We addressed an issue where the Gold Upgrade SBC was giving players a Small Gold Players Pack instead of the intended reward of a 2x 78+ Gold Players Pack.

tweets.author: EA SPORTS FC Direct Communication
tweets.text:
We are aware and investigating reports that some players are receiving Gold Player Items instead of TOTW Player Items from certain packs in FC 27.

We'll provide another update when available.

tweets.author: EA SPORTS FC Direct Communication
tweets.text: This issue has been addressed. Affected players will be messaged in-game with the corrected content in the coming days.
